assignment.title: Practical Assignment — Make Me Understand
assignment.description:
You have learned that being a good communicator is not simply about having something to say.

It is about making another person understand what you mean.

For this assignment, you are going to put that into practice.

YOUR TASK

Choose one idea, concept, topic, or experience that you understand well.

It could be:

- Something you learned in school
- A concept from your course
- Something about technology
- A social issue
- Something you are passionate about
- Something people commonly misunderstand
- A lesson you have learned from experience
- Any topic you believe you can explain well

Now imagine you are explaining it to someone who knows absolutely nothing about it.

Your job is to make them understand.

You are not giving a formal presentation.

Think of it as a conversation with an invisible person who is sitting in front of you and genuinely wants to understand what you are talking about.
assignment.instructions:
START YOUR VIDEO

Begin your video with:

"My name is [your name]. I am studying Communication & Public Speaking at Unify Creator Academy, and this is my very first assignment."

Then transition naturally into your explanation.

You can introduce your topic however you like.

The rest of the video should feel like you are talking to a real person, not reading an essay or delivering a memorised speech.


YOUR THREE NEW WORDS

There is one more challenge.

From the Surface Lexicon exercise in this module, choose three words that you rarely use or have never used before.

Use all three words naturally while explaining your topic.

Do not force them into your explanation simply to complete the requirement.

The words should actually make sense within what you are saying.

For example, if you learned a new word that describes a particular feeling, idea, process, or situation, find a natural place where that word communicates your meaning more precisely.

IMPORTANT

You are not being asked to use complicated words to sound intelligent.

The purpose of this exercise is to practise bringing new vocabulary into your active vocabulary.

Your three words should help you communicate more precisely.

Include the three words in your caption when you post your video.


YOUR COMMUNICATION

While recording, focus on the skills you learned this week.

CLARITY

Make your message easy to understand.

CONCISENESS

Get to the point.

Avoid unnecessary words, repetition, and rambling.

SIMPLICITY

If your topic is complicated, break it down so that someone unfamiliar with it can follow your explanation.

PRECISION

Choose words that accurately communicate what you actually mean.

NATURAL DELIVERY

Talk as though you are genuinely explaining something to another person.

You do not need to sound overly formal.

You do not need to sound like a professional speaker.

You do not need to use big words.

Just communicate.


THE RULE

Do not try to sound intelligent.

Try to be understood.

Your vocabulary is a tool, not a performance.

If a simple word communicates your meaning better, use the simple word.

If an example makes your explanation easier to understand, use an example.

If you notice yourself going off-topic, bring yourself back.

Think about what you want the other person to understand.

Then communicate it.


BEFORE YOU POST

Watch your video once before submitting it.

Ask yourself:

- Is my topic clear?
- Did I get to the point?
- Can someone who knows nothing about this understand me?
- Did I explain the idea simply?
- Did I repeat myself unnecessarily?
- Did I ramble?
- Did I choose precise words?
- Did I naturally use my three new words?
- Does this sound like I am actually talking to someone?

If you can improve it, record it again.

Your first attempt does not have to be your final attempt.


SUBMISSION

STEP 1 — POST YOUR VIDEO

Post your completed video on your Instagram page.

Your caption must include:

What I learned from UCA this week.

Also include the three new words you used in your explanation.

You may add a short personal declaration about the communicator you are becoming.

STEP 2 — COPY YOUR LINK

After posting your video, copy the link to your Instagram post.

STEP 3 — SUBMIT YOUR LINK

Go to the UCA Assignment Portal and submit the link to your Instagram post in the designated assignment section.

Make sure your post is accessible so that your work can be reviewed.


SUBMISSION WINDOW

Opens: Wednesday

Deadline: Friday, 11:59 PM

Make sure you submit before the deadline.
assignment.requirements:
HOW YOU WILL BE GRADED

Your assignment will be reviewed based on how effectively you demonstrate the communication skills taught in Module 1.

1. CLARITY

Is the topic easy to understand?

Does the listener know what you are trying to communicate?

2. CONCISENESS

Do you get to the point?

Have you avoided unnecessary words, repetition, and rambling?

3. SIMPLICITY

Can someone unfamiliar with the topic follow your explanation?

4. PRECISION & WORD CHOICE

Are you choosing words that accurately communicate what you mean?

5. USE OF NEW VOCABULARY

Did you successfully use three new or rarely used words naturally and correctly?

6. NATURAL COMMUNICATION

Does your delivery feel like you are genuinely explaining something to another person rather than simply reading or reciting a script?


THE CHALLENGE

Everyone knows something.

But knowing something and being able to make another person understand it are two different skills.

You have spent this module learning how to close that gap.

Now show us.

Choose something you understand.

Find the right words.

Make your point.

Make me understand.
